findings.summary: scripts/bump_patch.sh only bumps package.json + tauri.conf.json. Cargo.toml [package].version stays at 2.2.31 while the shipped app reports 2.2.35 via tauri.conf.json. The Rust panic hook writes app_version = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION") = "2.2.31" into ~/LiquidClips/.last-crash.json — Daniel's crash telemetry will misattribute panics to v2.2.31 instead of v2.2.35. Not blocking (Tauri user-visible version comes from tauri.conf.json), but the crash marker mismatch is worth patching next patch bump.
findings.evidence: desktop-2/src-tauri/Cargo.toml:2 `version = "2.2.31"`. desktop-2/scripts/bump_patch.sh:15-21 only sed-touches package.json + src-tauri/tauri.conf.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend bump_patch.sh with a third sed on Cargo.toml `^version = "…"` line. Out-of-scope for v2.2.35 (task spec says use bump_patch.sh as-is), surface for next release.

findings.summary: GitHub Environment `production` is left commented out (`# environment: production`). Fallback in effect is workflow_dispatch approval only. This is a documented choice (task spec) — repo tier may not support required-reviewers on private repos below the org tier. Uncomment the line once Daniel confirms the environment exists with required reviewers.
findings.evidence: release-desktop-2.yml flip-to-latest job · `# environment: production   # <-- enable once GitHub Environments w/ required reviewers is provisioned`
findings.reproduce: gh api /repos/${OWNER}/${REPO}/environments — returns 404 or empty if the environment doesn't exist.
